title: Mitosis extraction implementation: the twenty-two-MSP migration

completion_criteria.text: The host trunk is green at the exact commit the import will archive: every push-triggered workflow ran and passed there, and the secret scan's green is proven to have examined a non-zero byte count.
The repository exists, the import landed by git archive with no untracked file carried, and continuous integration runs on every pull request.
The suite is hermetic and tracked-files based: identical pass, fail and total counts from three locations, and an untracked ignored directory changes nothing.
A vacuous pass is structurally impossible: all six mutations make the lane exit non-zero, each with its fired message quoted.
Every dispatch outcome and review verdict in the engine's closed vocabularies reaches its declared terminal state through a free replay run.
The plugin loads from a published repository and the host carries no reference to the removed engine, with every continuous-integration job green in both repositories.

spine.active_goal: Migrate the mitosis engine into its own public repository as an installable plugin across twenty-two units, entirely on the Claude Code subscription, then remove it cleanly from the host.
spine.next_step: RE-RUN THE P9 CENSUS FIRST, at ea5cd118eb4b8e7948b1122cd59085e0c5d39188 - main moved twice this session so the earlier pass names a stale subject. Scan all four archive paths and read the unconfigured gitleaks count as the authoritative one. Then ship U2, REUSING the existing empty private SatanshuMishra/mitosis rather than creating it. Then U2b. The required-check command sits with the user and does not block U2.
spine.last_session: 2026-08-24: greened the host trunk rather than shipping a unit. Two pull requests merged, a banned wall-clock read and a secret-scan false positive. Four decisions, four plan amendments. Making the test check required proved agent-unreachable and is with the user.

open_risks.text: Ship the vacuity guard only after the hermetic and census units — its criterion is that a mutation makes the lane exit non-zero, and against a red baseline that proves nothing because the lane already failed
Never let two in-flight branches touch the package manifest or the lane runner — seven units edit the manifest and four edit the runner, so serialise those units rather than resolve a conflict
Cut every branch from a freshly fetched trunk — the enforcer diffs the base tip, so a branch cut before the base advanced reads the base's new files as its own deletions and fails a gate falsely
Recompute the import closure rather than trusting the SPEC's list — the SPEC states the recomputation wins, and a discrepancy is recorded in the pull request body rather than absorbed silently
Run the publication gate before visibility ever changes — a confidential codename sits in a gitignored file that git archive cannot carry, and a public push cannot be undone
Record every cost figure as a notional estimate — a subscription run reports a cost priced at API rates, so it is never a spend claim and no unit is sized by dollars
Verify a host rule is in force by reading the live file — the configuration directories symlink into the primary checkout, so a merged label does not mean the checkout pulled

Decide publication safety on the unconfigured secret scan — a path-scoped allowlist makes the scanner skip a matching file's content before its regex ever runs, so the configured count silently omits twelve files

Hand the required-status-check write to the human rather than dispatching it — the permission classifier blocks it and the platform agent refuses it on charter, so a re-route is laundering rather than routing
Never count commits to decide whether work landed — identical content can arrive under a different commit, and a squash of work already present merges as an empty commit that scans nothing
Re-measure the import base at the exact commit the unit will archive — the trunk moved twice in one session, so a carried-over pass names a stale tree

Reuse the empty private mitosis repository rather than creating it — U2's first step already ran before its dispatch was stopped, so the repository exists with no commits, and a delete-and-recreate is an avoidable irreversible action

key_decisions.title: Mitosis extracts to its own public repository as an installable plugin, migrated by hand
The extraction ships as twenty-two units in a corrected order, not the sixteen the spec listed
Everything runs on the Claude Code subscription; hermeticity is replaced by a recorded environment fingerprint
The contract lane runs locally on the subscription and CI verifies only freshness and the committed diff
The substrate seed bundles stay out of the extracted repository
Security review runs on six of twenty-two units, not on all of them
The repository is published at layer 5, not after the suite is green
The trunk is greened before the import is cut, not after
A blocking enforcer gate on a change's own lines is in scope, not a filed item
The import base must be proven green before the tree is copied
The required status check carries no bypass actor
P9 passes at the import base and its tree-scan findings defer to the publication unit

out_of_scope: Disposing of the stale branch and worktree field in the host repository
Maintaining the host suite after the engine is removed; it is asserted green at removal time only
Resolving the host's remaining secret-scan findings, including the second occurrence of the flagged literal; the publication unit runs the census and resolves whatever it reports
